about: Items as the vanilla item stands show them, measured by lab/extract_models.py (items, collect_items) and built by lab/build_models.js --items. b: bounds of the shown branch of the item prefab (its attach child, or attachobj) in its own frame, metres, from the LOD0 meshes; k: a low-poly proxy (boxes and prisms, packed as in piece-models.json, lib/mesh.js unpack) within tol of the mesh; at: per stand, the branch's position c, rotation q and scale s in the stand piece's frame (ItemStand.SetVisualItem, quality 1, first orientation); fits: whether ItemStand.CanAttach takes it on that stand; gap: the mesh's and the proxy's lowest point against the flat stand's top (itemstandh) and their back against the wall stand's face (itemstand), mm. No mesh data from the game.
